title: The sulking cat returns
odia:
ଛି ଲୋ ବିଲେଇ କାହିଁକି ରୁଷୁ
ସେଇ ଭାଡ଼ି ତଲେ ପୁଣି ପଶୁ।
literal_meaning: Tut, cat, why do you sulk? You go beneath that same raised storage platform again.
meaning_odia: ବିଲେଇକୁ ପଚରାଯାଉଛି—ସେହି ଭାଡ଼ି ତଳେ ପୁଣି ପଶୁଛୁ ଯଦି, ରୁଷୁଛୁ କାହିଁକି? ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଅଭିମାନ ଦେଖାଇଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ପୁଣି ପୂର୍ବ ଜାଗା ବା ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ଫେରିଆସିବାର ଅମେଳକୁ ଏହା ଚିଡ଼ାଉଛି। ଫେରିଆସିବାର କାରଣ କଥାଟି କହୁନାହିଁ।
explanation: The rebuke puts two actions side by side: taking offence and entering the same place again. Read editorially, it teases a sulk that does not become a lasting break. The speaker treats the return as undercutting the display of displeasure, although the verse leaves the reason for returning unstated.
usage_example: Original imagined example: After a small quarrel, a friend announces that they will stop attending the group’s games, then returns the next evening. Another friend teasingly recalls the cat going under the same platform again.
cultural_context: The raised platform gives the cat a familiar place to enter. The paired verbs ରୁଷୁ and ପଶୁ make the joke audible: taking offence in one line, going back in the next.

witnesses.locator: Page19, penultimate couplet beginning ଛି ଲୋ ବିଲେଇ.

english_summary: A sulk is followed by a return to the same place.
